As the optimizer pushes the metric upward, the gradient consistently drives Cr thickness toward the hard engineering floor (8 nm) because the optical performance continues to improve at thinner values within the operational bandwidth. This boundary attraction is a direct consequence of the material dispersion model and target spectral weighting, making the 8 nm limit the current physical optimum under these constraints.
